newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo to review Freegold marginal shafts.
newsitem.headline: Anglo to review Freegold marginal shafts.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd's gold division, Anglogold, said on Thursday the low gold price necessitated a review of all marginal shafts at Free State Consolidated Gold Mines Ltd.
Anglogold said in results for the June quarter that five shafts at Freegold -- the world's largest gold mine -- were identified at the end of the previous quarter as being in trouble.
It said the Western Holdings No 2 shaft was closed durign the June quarter and Western Holdings No 3 shaft is working towards orderly closure in the next three to six months.
"The low gold price necessitates a review of all marginal shafts and stakeholders will be advised of any decisions emanating from this," Anglogold said.
Anglogold said some unpayable sections at Freddies No 5 shaft were clsoed and performance has improved.
But similiar measures at President Steyn Nos 2 and 5 shafts have been less succesful and further remedial action will have to be taken.
It said the incline shaft at No 2 shaft will be closed.
The company said capital expenditure at Freegold has been reviewed in light of current production difficulities and the low gold price.

"It is now expected that capex will be reduced to 137 million for the financial year. Management is mindful that any further cutbacks could impact negatively in the long term, particularly at the developing Freegold 4," Anglogold said.
The group's capital expenditure for the three months to end-June was 24.5 million rand higher at 177.8 million.

At Vaal Reefs Exploration and Mining Company Ltd, capital expenditure for the quarter was 25 precent higher at 95 million rand but Anglogold said the forecast for the remainder of 1997 has been reduced to 400 million rand.
Capex at Western Deep Levels Ltd was 38 percent higher at 35.1 million rand.
The figure included 3.4 million for repairs neeeded to the short sub-vertical raise borehole at South Shaft to allow V-mole drilling to proceed.
Anglogold said the shaft sinking component of Western Deeps' South Shaft deepening project was six weeks ahead of schedule.
Capital expenditure at Elandsrand Gold Mining Co Ltd was 37 percent higher at 18.4 million rand.
Anglogold said this was below target.
